items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: I don't know no Charlie Hite.

ctx.x: It says, "Chicago Defender story...21st April 1928 edition said that Charlie Hite was with Mosby."
Well, that might have been. I don't know no Charlie Hite.
I don't either. And, the band at the Apex Club...that's right, the place that was later the Alabam was once the Apex, right? Or, no. There were two Apexes, weren't there? On Central Avenue?
